        If Zorland's capital has 3.2 million people and exports $5.8 billion in rare earth metals annually,
        what is the per-capita export value? Show your calculation.

Total export value = $5.8 billion
Population = 3.2 million

Per-capita export value = Total export value / Population

Per-capita export value = 1812.5
